nt_all_added: All available targets are already selected.
scan_off: Not known yet. The online lookup is off or no service is selected – set it under Settings → Global → "Look up barcodes online".
wl_hass_sub: Sidebar – visible to everyone in the household
wl_no_target: No target selected – nothing is sent.
wl_help: Products you are waiting to see on offer. Add them from an item's menu or in the offers card.
wl_notify: Notify when one of them is on offer
wl_notify_help: Home Assistant checks every 30 minutes – even with no dashboard open – and reports every offer once.
cur_symbol_help: Up to 6 characters, e.g. ₺, Rp or лв – shown after the amount and recognised as a price while typing.
cur_symbol_bad: Symbol not possible – no digits, spaces or @ # * + ~ !
price_auto: Fill in the remembered price automatically
price_auto_help: On: when an item returns to the list, its last price is shown. Off: prices are only kept in the history – an item only shows an offer or the price you type for this entry.
deal_help: “Take” attaches store, price and validity to the item. The price disappears when the offer expires.
offers_expired_help: Store, price and validity are removed from the item – the item stays on the list.
cur_help: For prices, totals and expenses. Recognised as a price while typing: {symbols}
price_how: How an item gets its price
price_how_note: The first source with a price wins. The list shows price × quantity; checking an item books the amount as an expense.
price_how_1: Offer (from the app or the offers card) – applies to the whole item until it expires.
price_how_2: Price in the text from another source ("… - 0,99 €") – per piece.
price_how_3: Own price – entered in the item or typed when adding ("Milk 2 l 2,38 €" remembers 1,19 per l).
price_how_4: Last paid (marked with ~) – booked when last checked off.
order_help: What comes first in the line below the item name. Applies to everyone – also in the app and on shared pages.
share_edit_help: Changes apply immediately for everyone who has the link. The link itself stays the same.
no_add: Adding is disabled for this list.
naming_help: A character in front of a word turns it into a badge. Applies to all lists and devices.
learned_help: Created when you pick a category manually.
ui_me_help: Applies to you only. Differences from the global setting are marked •.
automation_help: Assist and due items. Blueprints for “I'm at the store” and store reminders: see the wiki.
auto_voice_help: Used when a sentence names no list.
auto_due_help: Hourly, by your buying rhythm. “—” = off.
devices_help: Devices with the HA SmartLists app. ⚠️ = not synced for 7+ days. To revoke access, delete the token in the profile.
shop_large_help: Easier to hit with your thumb. Off: same size as the normal view.
new_list_help: You are the owner and can share it with others afterwards.
p_hint: Tap lists to show them side by side (more than 3 wrap into rows). Drag items with the mouse into another list to move them (Ctrl = copy).
p_empty: No to-do lists found. Add one under Settings → Devices & services → SmartLists – or with + above.
sharing_help: Who may see and change this list. Admins can always do everything. HA's to-do view shows every list to everyone – it is hidden only in SmartLists (card, page, app).
no_users: No other users in Home Assistant.
confirm_delete_list: Delete this list with all items?
due_every: due – you buy it about every
backup_help: Remembered categories, history, naming convention and controls as a file – e.g. for a second HA instance. Import adds without deleting anything.
stale_card: This card is outdated – reload the page (Ctrl+F5) or clear the frontend cache in the app.
imp_skip_dupes: Skip items already on the list
imp_text_help: One item per line. Bullets, [ ] / [x] and numbers are recognised, as are quantities and tags.
imp_no_lists: No other to-do lists found in Home Assistant.
no_targets: No other list you can write to.
ui_help: Every user sets this for themselves. Optionally different per device.
scope_help_household: Applies to everyone who hasn't set their own.
scope_help_user: Only your differences from the default are saved (marked •). “Reset” = back to default.
scope_help_device: Applies to this browser or device only. “Reset” = back to your setting.
row_buttons: Show pencil and bin in the row
packs_help: Keywords → category. Several packs can be active at once (e.g. English + your own). On equal keywords the pack higher up wins. Remembered categories always take precedence.
pack_name_help: Name for the pack. The same name replaces an existing custom pack.
card_desc: Shopping list with categories, suggestions, quantities, store badges (@REWE) and permissions.
e_pre_store: In the store (shopping mode, no input)
l_filter_store: Only store (e.g. REWE; several separated by commas)
l_filter_tags_new_items: New items get the filter tag (@REWE …)
l_drag_drop: Drag & drop (mouse): move to another list, reorder
l_show_offer: Offers from the app (store, price, valid until)
hh_preset: Sets matching options at once – afterwards everything can be changed individually.
hh_entities: Several lists: as tabs, side by side or stacked. All options apply to every list.
hh_filter_tags_new_items: Otherwise new items would disappear right away in a filtered card.
hh_show_settings: Gesture, menu and shopping mode are set by each user in the gear menu.
hh_show_category_titles: Off: sorted by category, but as one list with the category icon in front.
hh_start_shopping: Smartphone for a tablet in the hallway or a dashboard just for shopping.
shop_auto_store_help: When you are in a store's zone (e.g. REWE), shopping mode shows only its items.
shop_untagged: Also show items without a store
shop_untagged_help: In shopping mode for one store, additionally everything without @store.
pack_new_help: Empty pack, e.g. for another language or your own terms. It is activated at the top.
pack_empty: No keywords yet – add some above.
pack_builtin_edit_help: Built-in pack: changes go into the add-on pack “+” and survive updates.
zone_new_help: Name of the zone. Position: this device's current location (otherwise home), radius 100 m – fine-tune under Settings → Areas & zones.
zone_wait: Zone created – it appears in a moment, then link it here.
store_add_help: Name of the store, as in @REWE. A zone is created for it next.
stores_help: Link stores to Home Assistant zones. In shopping mode you then automatically see only the items of the store you are in.
notes_help: The HA SmartLists app stores notes as a to-do list of its own. They are not shopping lists and are therefore hidden by default.
notes_show_help: As a separate 📝 section on the page – not in Assist, actions or combined lists.
notes_none: No note list of the app found.
p_order_hint: ◀ ▶ moves a list. With the mouse: drag a chip onto another. The order also applies to the columns.
look_help: How badges look for all users. Store colours and names also apply in the app. Empty or ↺ = default.
look_add_help: With its character, e.g. @Kaufland, *Max or #vegan – even if not used yet.
zone_name: Zone name, e.g. REWE Standort Test
zone_no_location: Location not available – choose another option.
zone_after: Fine-tune any time under Settings → Areas & zones.
note_locked_help: Encrypted with the app's notes password – readable only in the app.
list_settings_hint: Controls and everything global: ⚙ at the top right of the page.
list_settings_hint_card: Controls and everything global: the slider icon in the header.
soft_checked_help: Someone marked this as done via a shared link – the item stays open until you check it off.
tpl_increase: already on the list → quantity is increased
tpl_items_help: One item per line, with quantity and tags as in the list. Servings (optional) = how many the quantities are for.
scan_help: Hold the barcode across the red line – or type the number below it.
scan_unknown: Product not found – please type the name yourself.
scan_no_camera: Camera scanning is not supported here (e.g. iPhone Safari, Firefox) – type the number.
aisle_help: This is how shopping mode sorts when this store is selected. Drag the handle ⠿ or use the arrows.
notify_no_phone: No device with the companion app found.
notify_help: When someone else changes something (your own changes only if switched on below). Several changes within a minute arrive as one message.
stats_help: From the existing history – no additional data is collected.
exp_none: No expenses yet – they are booked when items with a price are checked off.
exp_help: Booked when checking off (price × quantity). Prices come from offers, by hand (e.g. “Milk 2 l 1.19€” or ✏️) or from the last purchase.
share_mode_help: “soft”: you see what was marked – the item stays open in your list. Items added via the link are marked with 🔗 in your list.
stores_none: No stores yet. Add one with “＋ Store” or just write @REWE on an item.
store_add_help2: Name of the store, e.g. EDEKA. It is then offered while typing; you can link a zone afterwards.
look_none: No stores or people in use yet.
look_tag_kind: Tags are set above under “Per kind” – that applies to all of them.
freq_reset_q: Reset “Frequently bought” of this list? Other lists, categories and statistics stay.
ui_lang_help: Language of SmartLists – can differ from Home Assistant.
naming_all_used: Every kind already has a character.
nt_pick: Please tap at least one target.
share_approve_help: Items added via the link appear in the list only after your okay.
people_none: Nobody but you yet – whoever is not added has no rights.
people_legend: View = look only · Check off = view and check off · Edit = also add, change, delete. Whoever is not listed has no access; admins may always do everything.
shop_longpress_delete_help: In shopping mode, long-press an item to delete it (undo at the bottom).
share_notes_help: An item's note appears on the shared page (offers always do).
share_password_help: Whoever opens the link has to enter it. Stored only as a hash.
share_people_moved: People and permissions are in the share window.
stats_reset_all_q: Forget all purchases and buying rhythms? Suggestions while typing stay. Expenses are separate.
stats_reset_sel_q: Remove {n} items from the statistics (purchases and rhythm)?
exp_delete_all_q: Delete all bookings? The expenses overview starts at 0 again.
offline_help: No connection to Home Assistant. Checking off, adding and editing keep working and are sent as soon as the connection is back.
offline_nodata: Offline – this list has never been opened on this device.
x_stats_help: Bought most often, not bought for a while, shares per category and store, monthly expenses (📊 on the page, sensor “Expenses this month”). Off: hidden, counting continues in the background.
w_x_stats_sub: What you buy often and how much you spend
link_added_help: Someone without an account added this via a shared link.
link_shared_help: Reachable via {n} link(s) for people without an account. Tap to view or revoke the links.
shared_change_hint: To change: gear of this list → Sharing.
l_plain_help: No categories, suggestions, remembered words or prices. SmartLists remembers nothing from this list – its items never show up in other lists (e.g. hardware store).
l_categories_help: Off: no sorting into categories – neither in the list nor while typing. Sort e.g. by added instead.
l_suggest_help: What was bought in another list does not show up here. Older entries (before 3.9.4) still apply everywhere.
zone_dup_text: There already is a zone “{name}”. You can keep the name (then there are two zones with the same name, e.g. two branches) or rename the new zone, e.g. “{name} Downtown”.
zone_dup_rename_help: Name of the new zone, e.g. with the area or street of the branch.
app_title: Save as app on the home screen
app_lead: An icon on your phone that opens this list directly – no extra app. Runs full screen like an app.
app_ios:
In Safari tap Share (□↑) at the bottom
Choose Add to Home Screen
Tap Add – done
app_android:
In Chrome tap ⋮ at the top right
Choose Add to Home screen or Install app
Confirm Install – done
app_other:
In the browser menu choose Install app or Add to Home screen
On the phone: open this page in Chrome (Android) or Safari (iPhone)
x_help: Optional areas. Not needed to get started – switch them on here when you want them.
x_notes_help: Note lists (e.g. from the HA SmartLists app) as a separate 📝 section. Who sees them is set under Devices and notes.
x_mealplan_help: Dishes per day, ingredients onto the list, “Meal plan” calendar. Off: tab, menu entry and calendar disappear, planned dishes stay saved.
w_x_optional: Optional – also later under Settings → Extras
w_x_notes_sub: Note lists as a separate section, e.g. from the app
w_x_mealplan_sub: Plan dishes per day and put the ingredients on the list
share_leak: The link contains the address of your Home Assistant. To keep it private: your own proxy (Settings → Sharing and permissions → Public address).
share_old_address: address has changed, link no longer works
pub_help: How shared links are reached. With your own proxy in front nobody learns the address of your Home Assistant.
pub_ha_help: As before: the link points to the external address of Home Assistant – whoever gets it knows that address.
pub_proxy_help: A reverse proxy or tunnel (Cloudflared add-on, Caddy, nginx …) with an address of its own points at Home Assistant and forwards only these paths: {paths}. Whoever gets the link only sees that address. If the proxy sends X-Forwarded-For, add it in Home Assistant under http: → trusted_proxies.
pub_moved: The built-in tunnel and the separate share server (port 8126) have been removed – links now go through Home Assistant. Point your tunnel or proxy at Home Assistant (only {paths}), check the address and save.
share_once: The link is shown only now – it is not stored. Later: revoke and create a new one.
share_local: This is an address from your home network – from outside the link only works with an external URL (Settings → System → Network).
share_help: For people without a Home Assistant account. They only see this list (notes only if you allow them) – nothing else from Home Assistant. Default: view only.
barcode_lookup_help: Only the number and the language of your Home Assistant (for the product name) are sent, and only to the services you select below. Off (default): only codes already known, nothing leaves Home Assistant.
app_list_pending: Combined list from the app – not connected in Home Assistant yet
app_list_admin: A Home Assistant admin can connect it (tap here or under Connected devices).
share_combined: Note: a combined list shares the items of all its source lists.
trip_help: The “in cart” total starts at 0 again. Expenses stay booked. For lists you reuse, you can reopen everything checked right away.
stats_forget_help: is removed from statistics, suggestions and buying rhythm (e.g. added by mistake).
notes_create_help: Name of the note list. It belongs to you; created as todo.ha_smartlists_notes_<name>.
scan_native_help: Point the camera at the barcode on the package.
scan_not_product: This is not a product barcode (EAN).
scan_mode_input: into the input field (check, then add)
barcode_providers_help: No service is preselected. Tap to turn on/off, the number is the order – the first hit counts. SmartLists remembers found codes.
barcode_custom_agent: Own User-Agent (empty = the one of SmartLists)
a_global_sub: Applies to all users, also in the app.
a_rights_sub: What users without admin rights may do.
rights_who_editors: everyone who may edit the list
rights_limits_help: The limits apply to users without admin rights.
rights_all_links: Show active links of all lists
rights_share_help: Links give people without an account access to a single list.
ls_list_help: Applies to this list on all devices, unless a card or a device sets something else.
w_lists_h: What would you like to start with?
w_lists_found: SmartLists found {n} to-do lists in Home Assistant.
w_lists_none: There is no to-do list in Home Assistant yet.
w_use_sub: They stay as they are. SmartLists shows them with categories, quantities and stores.
w_combine_sub: Everyone keeps their list, the shared one shows all of them.
w_new_sub: Only in SmartLists; you are the owner and can share it.
w_stores_lead: The stores are offered while typing, and shopping mode shows only what you need in that store.
w_stores_later: You can add the stores' locations later. Then SmartLists picks the store by itself when you are there.
w_naming_h: How do you mark store, person and tag?
w_naming_lead: A character right before a word turns it into a badge. It stays in the item text, so Home Assistant and the app see it too.
w_naming_hint: Allowed are {chars}. Leave empty to turn a kind off. The HA SmartLists app takes these characters when pairing.
w_lang_h: In which language do you write items?
w_lang_lead: This is how SmartLists recognises the category, for example milk in chilled. Several languages work together.
w_people_lead: Permissions for the new list. Everyone sees SmartLists in their sidebar.
w_people_combined: Combined lists are visible to everyone who sees the source lists. Per-person permissions exist for own SmartLists lists.
w_app: HA SmartLists app on a device
w_app_sub: In the app, tap “Pair” under Settings → Connection. Connected devices then appear under Global → Devices and notes.
w_extras_lead: Everything can be turned on and off later.
w_x_notify: Tell me when someone adds something
w_x_notify_sub: To your device with the Home Assistant app
w_x_notify_none: No device with the Home Assistant app found
w_x_voice_sub: “Put milk on the shopping list” with Assist
w_x_prices_sub: Total of the list and a monthly overview
w_x_barcode_sub: Only the number and the language are sent. You pick the service yourself afterwards: Settings → Global
w_x_share: Owners may share lists via link
w_x_share_sub: For people without a Home Assistant account, for example neighbours or guests
w_done_lead: This will be set up. You can change everything any time in the settings.
w_tip: Tip: just start typing in the input field, for example “2 kg apples @REWE”.
w_later: Can be changed later in the settings
w_restart_sub: The first-start assistant, e.g. to combine more lists.
mp_help: Dishes are templates. “Add ingredients to list” puts everything of this week on the list; equal items are added up. The plan also appears as a calendar in Home Assistant.
db_help: Creates a view of its own in the sidebar: one sub-page per list, plus meal plan and statistics (if switched on). Creating again updates it. Can be edited like any dashboard afterwards.
rs_help: Choose what to reset. The setup assistant starts afterwards. To-do lists and their items are never deleted; users' personal settings stay.
rs_settings_sub: Naming convention, badges and colours, stores and zones, aisle orders, permissions, voice and automations, list display, keyword packs.
rs_data_sub: Remembered categories, history and statistics, prices and expenses, templates and meal plan.
rs_combined_sub: Only the combined view – the source lists stay unchanged.
mp_ask_add: Add this week's ingredients to the list now?
notify_own_sub: e.g. when you add something on the PC and want it on your device – or to try it out.
notify_test_sent: Test message sent – if it doesn't arrive, check the companion app and its notification permission.
nt_none: No target yet – no messages will be sent.
nt_custom_help: Any service (admins only), e.g. telegram_bot.send_message or script.my_message. Data as JSON; {title} and {message} are replaced – without placeholders, title and message are added.
nt_help: Several targets are possible: companion app, Telegram, e-mail, Signal, speakers … – anything Home Assistant knows as a notification.
mg_sub: Take existing to-do lists (shopping list, Local To-do …) over into own SmartLists lists – with items, notes and checkmarks.
mg_help: The new lists belong to you and can be shared afterwards. Pick one or more lists.
mg_one_sub: All items together in one new list.
mg_used: Used in combined lists: {lists}. Add the new list there before you delete the old one.
mg_pick: Please pick at least one list.
mg_keep_info: The old list stays unchanged. Check the new list and delete the old one yourself afterwards.
mg_done_hint: The old lists still exist. When everything is fine in the new list, please delete them yourself (Settings → Devices & services, e.g. Local To-do or the respective integration):
mg_done_combined: At least one old list is a source of a combined list – add the new list there first.
mg_as_list_sub: Own SmartLists list with categories, quantities and shopping features.
mg_as_notes_sub: New note list (visible only to you), notes with title and text – encrypted ones are kept as they are.
owner_combined_help: With an owner, only they, admins and the people shared with see the list.
lb_help: Shows on each item which list it comes from.
lb_show_help: Source lists without an owner (Local To-do …) always show the list name.
lb_colors: Colour per source list (default: automatic, a different one per list)
dc_missing_sub: Offer hints in the list and the offers card for the dashboard come from a project of their own. Install it through HACS (Dashboard):
bk_sub: Writes everything SmartLists stores to a file in Home Assistant’s configuration folder: lists, items, owners, shares, permissions and settings. When the integration is removed this happens automatically.
bk_foreign: Source lists of other integrations: {n} (copy for safety, not restored)
bk_more: Also: {n} settings, permissions, learned categories and history, notes, share links, watch list, templates, paired devices and notifications.
due_remind: Remind me when it is due
bug_note: The report opens as a new issue on GitHub, with versions, place and browser. There you see the whole text and describe the problem; it only becomes public when you submit it on GitHub. Names of lists, items or notes are not included.
bug_need_where: Choose where the problem occurred first.
xt_title: Copy as a normal to-do list
xt_sub: For everyone who wants to remove SmartLists again and keep their lists: each list becomes a local to-do list of Home Assistant with the same items. The SmartLists list stays as it is.
xt_help: Copied: text, note, done/open, due date. Cannot be carried over: rights, soft marks, prices, favourites. A combined list is copied as one merged list.
linked_help: This list belongs to another service. The items are stored there; SmartLists shows them and passes changes on.
crash_sub: The list could not be shown.
pb_sub: Hard errors SmartLists has recorded since the last start – each with a code, so they can be reported precisely.
bug_detail: Include the technical details of this error (may contain names of lists or entities)
offer_bonus_help: Bonus offer: normal price, the credit only comes with the {store} app.
